meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Supports audited local Geniml genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 校验基因组区间数据,规划区域与单细胞嵌入模型的运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有 BED 等基因组区间数据,需要确认它们能否喂给嵌入模型。
copy.tagline_en: Validate genomic interval data and plan region and single-cell embedding model runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have BED interval data and need to confirm it fits embedding models.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 geniml 的本地流程帮你处理 BED 基因组区间数据：校验 BED 与 universe、规划 Region2Vec 或 scEmbed 训练、检查模型与分词器兼容性、评估 consensus universe。
howto.when: 当你处理 BED 基因组区间数据，或要训练 Region2Vec、scEmbed 等嵌入模型时触发；也用于构建 consensus peaks（universe）。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs geniml's local workflows on BED genomic-interval data: validating BED and universe contracts, planning Region2Vec or scEmbed training, checking model and tokenizer compatibility, and assessing consensus universes.
howto.when_en: Use when working with BED genomic-interval data or training embeddings such as Region2Vec, BEDspace, or scEmbed, and when building consensus peaks (universes).

say_en.text: Run Region2Vec training on these BED files
say_en.note: Tokenizes first, then trains and outputs embeddings

say_en.note: Produces a peak set for tokenization

say_en.text: Evaluate the quality of this universe
